CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Susan Jakubowski, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Steve Talt, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 13, 2022 AT 6:00 P.M.
  SAN MARINO CENTER
  1800 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with
valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, adjourned
meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact
the City Clerk via email at cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-0705 prior
to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that members of
the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s current Health
Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to provide input
electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84117680008
  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 841 1768 0008
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – JULY 13, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 7

How to offer public comment from home:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day of the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment. Lengthy
  public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments received after
  3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the
  meeting.
  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Huang, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Council
  Member Ude, Vice Mayor Talt, and Mayor Jakubowski

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall, 2200
Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman Building,
1560 Pasqualito Drive.  The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to
state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READINGS

This action permits the City Council to act on ordinances and resolutions without having to read
the entire text of the ordinance or resolution. The title of an ordinance on First Reading must
be read in its entirety. An ordinance on Second Reading does not require having the title read.
However, the City Council may request that an ordinance or resolution be read in its entirety
before taking any action.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – JULY 13, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 7

  PRESENTATION

1. PRESENTATION OF PARKS AND RECREATION MONTH PROCLAMATION

  NEW BUSINESS

2. CONSIDERATION OF VACANCY TAX BALLOT MEASURE AND APPROVAL
  AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS PERTAINING TO A SPECIAL
  MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 8, 2022
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-31,
  calling and giving notice of the holding of a special municipal election to be held on Tuesday,
  November 8, 2022; and Resolution No. R-22-32, requesting the Board of Supervisors of the
  County of Los Angeles consolidate the special municipal election with the statewide general
  election.

3. AUTHORIZATION FOR THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE A LETTER OF
  AGREEMENT FOR THE PARTICIPATION IN A MOBILE CRISIS UNIT
  COHORT PILOT PROGRAM WITH THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL
  OF GOVERNMENTS
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the City’s participation in
  the San Gabriel Valley Council of Government’s Mobile Crisis Unit Pilot Program, and
  authorize the City Manager to execute a letter of agreement on behalf of the City.

4. APPROVAL OF ORDINANCE NO. O-22-1396 (FIRST READING) AN
  ORDINANCE REPEALING ORDINANCE NO. O-20-1362-U PERTAINING TO
  EVICTIONS
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council waive full reading and introduce
  for first reading by title only, Ordinance No. O-22-1396, an Ordinance of the City Council of
  the City of San Marino Repealing Ordinance No. O-20-1362-U Pertaining to Evictions.

5. APPROVAL OF ORDINANCE NO. O-22-1393 (FIRST READING) AMENDING
  THE CITY CODE TO MAKE UPDATES TO THE FILM POLICY
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council waive full reading and introduce
  for first reading by title only, Ordinance No. O-22-1393 an Ordinance of the City Council of
  the City of San Marino Amending the City Code to make edits to the Film Policy.

6. APPROVAL OF ADDITIONAL PUBLIC TREES FOR REMOVAL TO BE
  INCLUDED ON THE SPRING 2022 TREE REMOVAL LIST
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the proposed tree
  removal list and authorize the Director of Parks and Public Works to move forward to
  properly remove the trees on the list.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – JULY 13, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 7

7. APPROVAL OF ORDINANCE NO. O-22-1395 (FIRST READING) AMENDING
  CHAPTER 17.02 OF THE CITY CODE REGARDING RESTRICTIONS ON PARK
  RESTROOMS
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council waive full reading and introduce
  for first reading by title only, Ordinance No. O-22-1395, an Ordinance of the City Council of
  the City of San Marino, California Amending Chapter 17.02 of the San Marino Municipal Code
  pertaining to restrictions on park restrooms.

8. RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR THIRD QUARTER (JANUARY
  2022 THROUGH MARCH 2022)
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the financial report
  reflecting the City’s revenues and expenditures as of March 31, 2022.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

9. RECEIVE AND FILE THE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR JUNE
  2022

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of June 2022.

10. RECEIVE AND FILE CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR MAY 2022

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for the month of May 2022.

11. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the regular meeting of
  June 8, 2022, the special meeting of June 17, 2022, the adjourned regular meeting of June 24,
  2022, and the special meeting of July 1, 2022.

12. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-30 TO CONTINUE HYBRID PUBLIC
  MEETINGS PURSUANT TO AB 361

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-30 re-
  authorizing the City Council and the City’s Boards and Commissions to continue
  teleconference accessibility for conducting public meetings pursuant to AB 361.

13. UPDATE ON CITY RESPONSE TO THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the July 13, 2022
  report on the City’s response to the COVID-19 Pandemic.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – JULY 13, 2022  PAGE 5 OF 7

14. APPROVAL OF TEMPORARY CLOSURE OF LACY PARK ON OCTOBER 29,
  2022 FOR THE GOODEN CENTER OF PASADENA TO HOST A 5K RUN FOR
  RECOVERY EVENT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council authorize a temporary closure of
  Lacy Park on October 29, 2022, and to charge $729 for the Lacy Park permit fee for The
  Gooden Center Run for Recovery, not including insurance, inspection fees, maintenance, and
  other City support costs required to conduct the event.

15. ADOPTION OF SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS
  WILDLIFE MANAGEMENT FRAMEWORK

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the San Gabriel Valley
  Council of Governments’ Wildlife Management Framework.

16. APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-29, AUTHORIZING THE CITY
  MANAGER TO EXECUTE A TRANSFER AGREEMENT WITH THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT FOR TRANSFER OF SAFE
  CLEAN WATER (SCW) FUNDS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Resolution No. R-22-29,
  authorizing the City Manager to execute a Transfer Agreement with the Los Angeles County
  Flood Control District for Transfer of Safe Clean Water (SCW) Funds.

17. RATIFICATION OF FUEL PROCUREMENT FOR THE CITY’S FLEET FROM
  SOUTHERN COUNTY FUELS IN THE AMOUNT OF $34,704 AND APPROVAL
  TO PROCURE ADDITIONAL FUEL FROM SOUTHERN COUNTY FUELS IN
  AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $45,765

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council ratify the procurement of
  unleaded fuel and diesel fuel from Southern County Fuels for the City’s fueling station in the
  amount of $34,704, and approve the future procurement of unleaded and diesel fuel in the
  amount not to exceed $45,765.

18. RATIFICATION OF THE CALIFORNIA STATE LIBRARY REPORT FOR
  FISCAL YEAR 2020-21

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council ratify the California State Library
  Report for fiscal year 2020-21.

19. ACCEPTANCE OF $30,000 DONATION FROM THE FRIENDS OF THE
  CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council accept the donation of $30,000
  from the Friends of the Crowell Public Library.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – JULY 13, 2022  PAGE 6 OF 7

20. APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH COLUMBIA TELECOMMUNICATIONS
  CORPORATION  FOR THE  PROVISION, INSTALLATION,  AND
  MAINTENANCE OF ADVANCED NETWORK SERVICES AT THE CROWELL
  PUBLIC LIBRARY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the agreement with
  Columbia Telecommunications Corporation for the provision, installation, and maintenance
  of advanced network services, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on
  behalf of the City.

21. APPROVAL OF REQUEST TO CLOSE THE LIBRARY ON OCTOBER 15, 2022
  FOR SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION’S FUNDRAISER
  EVENT, LITERARY LIBATIONS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the closure of the
  Crowell Public Library on October 15, 2022 for the purpose of holding the Literary Libations
  event.

22. APPROVAL OF REQUEST TO CHANGE THE FORMAT OF THE MINUTES
  FROM “SUMMARY” TO “ACTION” FOR THE LIBRARY BOARD OF
  TRUSTEES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the change of the format
  of minutes from ‘summary’ to ‘action’ for the Library Board of Trustees.

23. AUTHORIZATION  TO PREPAY CALPERS FY 2022-23  UNFUNDED
  ACCRUED LIABILITY (UAL) AMORTIZATION PAYMENTS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council authorize staff to prepay all of the
  City’s Fiscal Year 2022-23 unfunded accrued liability amortization payments to CalPERS in
  the total amount of$2,954,941, and to make such payments no later than July 31, 2022.

24. APPROVAL OF THE CITY MANAGER AS A VOTING DELEGATE
  ALTERNATE FOR THE CALIFORNIA JOINT POWERS INSURANCE
  AUTHORITY 2022 ANNUAL BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve City Manager Marlowe
  as a voting delegate alternate for the California JPIA’s 2022 Annual Board of Directors
  Meeting.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received
by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at
least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at
the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108,
and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City
Council meeting.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT
